name: Output Trajectory is a Function
description: Theorem stating that the output trajectory is a total, single-valued function from TZ to OZ, and equals RZ(STZ(f, x)(t)).

elements.text: OTZ(f, x)(t) = RZ(STZ(f, x)(t)) for any t ∈ TZ.

fidelity_note: Lean OTZ=RZ∘STZ; textbook citation A1.249/250 is an erratum — proof_comparison §3.
